title: Nexus: A Brief History of Information Networks from the Stone Age to AI
author: Yuval Noah Harari
summary: Yuval Noah Harari traces how information networks, from stories and writing to printing and algorithms, have shaped societies, and asks what happens as artificial intelligence takes a hand.
readIf: you like big-picture history with a focus on technology and power.
skipIf: you want technical detail on AI or find sweeping generalisations frustrating.
